titulo: Connect to Claude Code/Codex, automatic tests and Registry (preview)
lead: A server is ready when your agent uses it and a test checks it on every change. In this lesson you run the kit's automatic test suite, connect the server to Claude Code and to Codex from your subscription, and prepare the server.json for the official Registry, which is still in preview. It closes with the map and your plan.
objetivo: connect the server to Claude Code and Codex, run the automatic test suite, and prepare the server.json for the Registry, which is in preview.

aprende.t: Test suite with node --test: new era, old era, schema, MRTR and stdio
claude mcp add and codex mcp add, and what each one writes
server.json and mcp-publisher validate, without publishing
The course map and the plan with dates

hero_alt: Notebook with a blurred terminal and test lines, a connector being plugged into a mini server and a clipboard.

secoes.titulo: From the kit to the agent you use

nos.detalhe: Seven tests with no port, no model and no cost. Run them before every commit: if the protocol revision or the SDK changes, this is where you find out.
Registers the command that starts the server. Project scope writes .mcp.json to the folder and asks for approval the first time you open claude there.
Saves the server to ~/.codex/config.toml (Codex's global scope).
Official server catalog, metadata only. In preview: breaking changes and data resets may happen. Publishing requires a verified namespace.

secoes.sub: The official client talks to the handler in the same process; the last test starts the real stdio process.

The timings change on every run; what matters is ℹ fail 0. The test for the new revision uses handler.fetch: the in-memory pair (InMemoryTransport) only connects the 2025 era.

secoes.titulo: Connect it to Claude Code and Codex
secoes.sub: Local commands: they don't call a model. Run them in the kit folder (or in your server's folder).

blocos.conteudo:
cd ~/projetos/formacao-webmcp-mcp-v72/kit
claude mcp add -s project turmas -- node "$PWD/stdio.mjs"
claude mcp get turmas

cd ~/projetos/formacao-webmcp-mcp-v72/kit
codex mcp add turmas -- node "$PWD/stdio.mjs"
codex mcp list

abas.html:

Run claude once in that folder and approve the turmas server. After that, claude mcp list should show the server's line ending in ✔ Connected (format seen on other servers; this approval was not captured).

The command wrote a [mcp_servers.turmas] block to Codex's config.toml, with command = "node" and the path to stdio.mjs. The capture was made with a separate configuration folder (CODEX_HOME), so the author's own configuration stayed untouched.

secoes.titulo: The agent is going to reserve a seat
secoes.sub: Simulation: you're in Claude Code with the turmas server connected. Pick your reply.

personagem.papel: Claude Code with the turmas server

pedido.cliente: I found class html-01 with 3 seats. Want me to call reservar_vaga for aluno@exemplo.com? The tool has consequences and will ask for confirmation.

opcoes.t: Go ahead and call it. When the confirmation shows up, I'll answer.
opcoes.comenta: Right. The tool asks for the yes in the middle of the call (MRTR) and you decide on the spot, seeing the class and the email.

opcoes.t: Always approve this tool, so it stops asking me.
opcoes.comenta: Approving a tool with consequences forever removes the human exactly where they matter most.

opcoes.t: First, search again so I can see the updated seats.
opcoes.comenta: No harm done (searching is read-only), but the seat is checked inside reservar_vaga anyway.

busca.cliente: buscar_turmas returned html-01 with 3 seats. Should I go ahead with the reservation?

opcoes.comenta: OK, you got to the same point with one extra call.

confirma.cliente: The tool asks: Reserve 1 seat in "HTML semântico para agentes" for aluno@exemplo.com? Should I say yes?

opcoes.comenta: A conscious confirmation: the class and the email are right there in the question.
Great use of no: the tool returns isError and nothing changes.

sempre.cliente: Okay. Can I also approve the next bookings on my own, without asking you?

opcoes.t: No. Bookings always go through me.
opcoes.comenta: You corrected the course: consequential actions ask for confirmation again.
Fast and with no brakes: a misleading description or a misunderstood request turns into a real booking.

fim-ok.texto: The tool only acted after your confirmation, with the class and email in the question.

fim-recusa.texto: The no became isError and the seat is still there. This is the path the lesson 5 test checks.

fim-adiado.texto: No call with consequences, no risk. Ask again whenever you like.

fim-risco.texto: Standing approval on a tool with consequences is what course 4 calls taking off the brakes. Go back to asking for confirmation.

secoes.licao: A read-only tool can be approved without asking; a tool with consequences asks for your yes every time.

secoes.titulo: Describe the server for the Registry (without publishing)
secoes.sub: Registry in preview as of 10/19/2026. You need mcp-publisher (releases of the modelcontextprotocol/registry repository). validate queries registry.modelcontextprotocol.io and publishes nothing.

blocos.conteudo:
cd ~/projetos/formacao-webmcp-mcp-v72/kit
mcp-publisher validate      # reads server.json from the folder; publishes nothing
echo "saída: $?"

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and the rule I created

perguntas.p: Why does the test suite use handler.fetch and not InMemoryTransport to test the new revision?
opcoes: handler.fetch is faster, so it's the recommended one
The in-memory pair only connects the 2025 era
handler.fetch skips the client and calls the handler directly
perguntas.explica: The SDK v2 docs: createLinkedPair connects only 2025-era instances; handler.fetch is the in-process entry point for 2026-07-28.

perguntas.p: After claude mcp add -s project, claude mcp get shows Pending approval. What's missing?
opcoes: Open claude in the folder and approve the server
Publish the server to the official Registry before using it
Generate an OAuth token and pass it in the connection header
perguntas.explica: A project server (.mcp.json) asks for approval the first time. Once approved, ✔ Connected appears.

opcoes: Publishes the server to the Registry
Tests the server's tools by calling each one
perguntas.explica: It validates against the Registry and does not publish. Publishing is a separate command and requires a verified namespace.

perguntas.p: As of 10/19/2026, how should the official Registry be treated?
opcoes: As a preview, subject to change and reset
As a replacement for npm to distribute the package
As a closed list only for companies
perguntas.explica: The Registry itself warns: preview, with possible breaking changes and data resets.
